name: com.rabbidwolf.com.kyle.flooding
description: Gameplay-focused, volume-based flooding simulation for Unity.

samples.description: Cutaway four-compartment barge with visible water, Game-view COM markers, keyboard presets, and sample-only spring support showing Rigidbody roll/pitch from flood mass.
Demonstrates immutable pre-baked curved hull-section occupancy, authored source mesh, baked-cell visualization, and a gravity-aligned free surface.
Demonstrates conserved bidirectional pressure-driven flow and diagnostics between two finite rectangular compartments.
Demonstrates pressure-driven bidirectional flow between an infinite external fluid boundary and one finite compartment.
First-person rising flood with waterline crossing, optional URP underwater effects, audio muffling, and telemetry.
